title: Retire paint dependencies safely
scope: Define paint-field ownership when its body, mesh or simulation is replaced/reset.
acceptance: Repeated create/replace/reset remains within declared memory.
Stale paint endpoints fail deterministically and unrelated fields survive.
evidence: PASS: PM_DRIVER_FILES=$PWD/build-foundations/Release/manifests/test-slang-cpu-paint-resources.json ./build-foundations/tests/api/parallel-mater-paint-lifecycle-tests; ThomasLaptop Slang CPU host fixture; full 18-slot mesh table, failed replacements, endpoint guards and reset/reuse
PASS: ctest --test-dir build-foundations --output-on-failure -j1; ThomasLaptop; 41/41 passed with three unsupported production CPU domain cases skipped

PASS: Shader portability run 38987743747; Ubuntu 43/43 and macOS 44/44 execute host paint lifecycle; Windows 43/43 compile/runtime contracts; https://github.com/tabutyn/parallel-mater/actions/runs/38987743747
PASS: cmake --build build-desktop-switch --target parallel-mater-paint-lifecycle-tests -j1; CUDA and Vulkan drivers compile; runtime cases explicitly skip because no paint-capable device is available
